in_sanskrit.name: Parm
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Supreme, Beyond
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parm एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Parm signifies the supreme being, beyond the reach of the physical world. It is a name that conveys a sense of divinity and transcendence.

in_hindi.name: परम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The highest or greatest, beyond comparison. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word परम (param) and is commonly used as a masculine name in India.

in_tamil.name: Parm
